rationale: Kaarel is a founding ML engineer at a $10M consumer AI startup focused on zero-shot matching problems, while David is a founder/investor at Inception Capital—creating a natural deal flow and expertise exchange. Kaarel's conviction around high-leverage consumer AI applications and shipping speed aligns well with what an early-stage investor evaluates, and David's venture background could offer strategic perspective as Known.com scales.
intro_message: Kaarel Kaarelson, meet David Gan — Kaarel's building consumer AI matching at Known.com (Forerunner-backed) and David invests in this space at Inception Capital.
